headline: Iranian Attack Sparks Fire at Industrial Plant in Bahrain; Material Damage Reported
summary: Bahrain's Interior Ministry said Civil Defence is working to control a fire at an industrial plant caused by an Iranian attack. Preliminary reports indicate material damage and no injuries.
why: Attacks on industrial facilities in the Gulf can disrupt regional supply chains and raise geopolitical risk premiums for energy and shipping.
original_headline: Ataque iraní provoca incendio en planta industrial de Baréin; reportan daños materiales
